notes: Knowledge base for spec §13's smell -> candidate-pattern relation. `implemented: true` entries are wired into scripts/design_patterns/opportunities.py; the rest are catalogued for a future detector and MUST NOT be applied automatically without the same kind of repeated, observed evidence detect_opportunities requires (spec §13's explicit ban on 'no encuentro X -> deberías usar X').

mappings.smell: repeated conditional dispatch on the same discriminator, selecting between algorithm variants
repeated conditional dispatch on a discriminator whose values resemble a lifecycle, with evidence of transitions between them
repeated complex construction with many constructor parameters at multiple call sites
repeated manual traversal of the same collection
repeated ad hoc conversion code translating between two incompatible APIs
growing combinations of optional behaviors layered onto an object ad hoc
repeated access-control, lazy-loading, or caching logic wrapping direct calls to the same object
the same subsystem orchestration sequence repeated at multiple call sites
a producer calling multiple concrete consumers directly and by name instead of a shared collection
the same multi-step sequence repeated with small per-case variations
manual undo/rollback logic reconstructing prior state field by field
many-to-many direct dependencies between components that only need to react to each other's changes
actions that need queueing, history, or undo but call their receiver directly today
duplicated logic handling a single element and a group of elements separately
large duplicated intrinsic state across many instances (requires measured evidence before claiming a performance benefit — spec §20/§21)
manual field-by-field copy of an existing instance repeated at call sites
multiple unrelated operations distributed across a stable class hierarchy via type checks
